dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I suspect battle is not the ultimate objective, but merely part of a process by which to advance towards a greater goal. Perhaps this place contains something you desire.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Let us proceed together, then. Whatever trial awaits us, we shall face it as one.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Should you find yourself gripped by fear or panic, simply retreat behind me and follow my lead.
